**Push berhasil!** Username: `kebumenaja`. Notebook sedang jalan dengan GPU.

Sekarang tunggu sampai selesai, lalu ambil hasil `nvidia-smi`.

action.command: export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; export KAGGLE_API_TOKEN="KGAT_60050eb732f8deb448367144c378a69c"; cd /workspace/project/kgtest; sed -i 's|PLACEHOLDER/kagpu-check|kebumenaja/kagpu-check|' kernel-metadata.json; for i in 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8; do sleep 25; S=$(kaggle kernels status kebumenaja/kagpu-check 2>&1); echo "[$i] $S"; echo "$S" | grep -qiE "complete|error" && break; done
